stories.title: Andrew Tate indicted in Romania, again.
stories.summary:
More than three years after Tate and his brother were arrested and indicted in Romania on charges of human trafficking, Reuters reports the DIICOT prosecuting unit has indicted Tate again. They’ve charged Tate for “trafficking minors, money laundering, sex with a minor and witness tampering and his brother Tristan for complicity.”
Both Tates were arrested in Miami in July after British authorities requested their extradition, and they are currently in jail in the US.
[Link: Romanian prosecutors indict Andrew Tate for trafficking minors, money laundering | https://www.reuters.com/world/romanian-prosecutors-indict-andrew-tate-trafficking-minors-money-laundering-2026-09-04/ | Reuters]
